question: In which of the following years was the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) launched by the Government of India to provide connectivity to unconnected habitations as part of a poverty reduction strategy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)** was launched by the Government of India in the year **2000**. It aims to provide connectivity to unconnected rural habitations through all-weather roads.
 
• This scheme was developed as a part of the Government’s **poverty reduction strategy**, recognizing the importance of rural roads in boosting economic growth and improving access to basic services.
 
• **Rural connectivity** under PMGSY ensures better access to markets, healthcare, education, and other essential services for people living in rural areas.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development and is funded by both the Central and State Governments. **Hence, the correct answer is 2000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Features of PMGSY:**

 
 
• The primary objective of PMGSY is to provide **all-weather road connectivity** to eligible unconnected habitations in rural areas. These are defined as those with a population of 500+ in plain areas and 250+ in hilly, tribal, or desert areas.
 
• The roads constructed under PMGSY are designed using modern engineering techniques to ensure durability and sustainability.
 
• PMGSY contributes significantly to **poverty reduction** by enhancing connectivity, reducing isolation, and promoting social and economic development.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Details:**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Rural Development** in collaboration with state-level agencies.
 
• Funds for PMGSY are shared between the **Central Government** (60%) and the **State Governments** (40%).
 
• The scheme uses a geographic information system (**GIS**) for planning and monitoring purposes.
 
 
 
• **Achievements:**
 
 
• Since its inception, PMGSY has significantly improved **rural infrastructure**, contributing to better agricultural productivity and increased access to healthcare and education.
 
• The scheme has helped in the construction of thousands of kilometers of roads, connecting previously isolated regions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Milestones:**

 
 
• PMGSY was launched on **December 25, 2000**, under the leadership of the then Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• The scheme is part of the broader effort to achieve **inclusive development** and bridge the urban-rural divide.
 
 
 
• **Challenges:**
 
 
• Implementation faces challenges such as **land acquisition issues**, delays in project completion, and maintenance concerns.
 
• Efforts are ongoing to address these challenges through better planning, use of technology, and increased funding.
